title: Tribunal repository configuration
description: All fields are optional. Paths resolve from the consuming repository root; absolute paths are also accepted. Configure paths, leg names, and gate switches, never credential values. Registry membership and file contents are checked by policy.mjs at runtime.

preset.description: Select a bundled registry. An explicit modelsFile takes precedence; without either field, models.default.json is used.

modelsFile.description: Path to a custom model registry. Copy and edit the bundled models.default.json; this overrides preset.

reviewerPromptPath.description: Path to the reviewer prompt. Defaults to the plugin's prompts/reviewer-default.md.

ledgerHome.description: Directory for monthly ledgers, isolation-probe.md, and goal-wall and merge-gate state. Defaults to ~/.tribunal/<repo-folder>-<root-path-hash>/.

goalsDir.description: Directory whose Markdown goals the reminder and goal wall check. Defaults to docs/reference/goals.

gates.description: Both gates default to true. Set either switch to false to opt out of that gate.

goalWall.description: Block the end of a reply for changed goals without a complete panel row for their exact bytes. Defaults to true.

mergeGate.description: Block identified PR merges without a recorded panel row. False restores the merge reminder. Defaults to true.

enabledLegs.description: Registry leg names to enable in addition to registry defaults. Names must exist in the selected registry.

disabledLegs.description: Registry leg names to disable. Disabling takes precedence over enabledLegs; names must exist in the selected registry.

envFile.description: Path to a gitignored NAME=VALUE file. The config stores only its path; an existing environment value takes precedence. No file is loaded by default, and a missing file is allowed.
